propositions: A new built-in plan-review criterion T15 must be authored with S1-S3 applicability gates and checks (a)-(d) covering risk naming, fast out-of-loop proof, prove-then-codify ordering, and scoped cleanup, with front-matter execution_mode set to agentic (not AGENT).
T15 must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM in registry.py and routed via criteria_routing.json with exec='AGENT', facet='overlay-derisk', overlay_routing='llm', and applies_at suppress_types=['bug'].
The rebar explain T15 command must output the criterion name, execution tier, facet, and full rubric body including all checks and anti-FP paragraph.
The regenerated plan-review-criteria-guide.md must include a complete T15 section with all four checks and narrative present.
Registry validators (check_registry_coverage, validate_packaged_routing, validate_criteria_guide) must pass with T15 integrated.
